vellum.$description: Vellum atmospheric scale — DISpatch-locked tier extension parallel to Tailwind v4's neutral families (slate / stone / gray / zinc / neutral). Concept-cited per CD2 §2.2 to atmosphere-as-physical-writing-substrate (CD1 thesis Concept 4). Hue range 75°–95° (warm-yellow / warm-cream); chroma range 0.005–0.06; warm-paper substrate register requires restraint. Forward-arc as standalone community OKLCH palette extension (vellum-tokens npm; CD2 Decision 2 cross-surface signal).

concept-citation.universal-concept: Atmosphere as physical writing substrate at high-luminance natural-light register (CD1 Concept 4)
reference-platforms: The Paris Review Pentagram-Willey (recycled paper warmth)

lane.$description: Lane pigments — three cosmology directional vectors expressed through Purgatorio-terraces per CD2 §4.2 Decision 5. Lane 3 Dispatch (Below — Inferno-infra surfacing) inherits accent-prime; Lane 1 Editorial (Surface — atmospheric paper substrate); Lane 2 Institutional (Above — Paradiso-charter descending). Lanes apply LOCALLY as accents per CD2 §4.1 — NOT global page gradients.

strong.$description: Lane 1 Editorial — warm-earth pigment family (terracotta range). Surface vector — the city itself, where citizens live and work. Approximate Tailwind v4 nearest: orange-700. Specific intensity values land at CD4 component pairing per CD2 §4.3 5b.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Surface register — atmospheric paper substrate (CD1 Concept 4); the city itself where citizens live and work (CD2 §4.2 cosmology integration)

strong.$description: Lane 2 Institutional — cool-mineral pigment family (graphite-blue range). Above vector — Paradiso-charter descending through Purgatorio-terraces. Approximate Tailwind v4 nearest: slate-700. Specific intensity values land at CD4 component pairing per CD2 §4.3 5c.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Above register — Paradiso-charter descending through Purgatorio-terraces; institutional weight inscribed from The Bar (9 Charter Spheres = what Prime aspires to be)

strong.$description: Lane 3 Dispatch — inherits accent-prime via DTCG aliasing per CD2 §4.3 5d. Below vector — Inferno-infra surfacing. Lane 3 dispatch content IS the visible Inferno-pulse at magazine-IA level: when a missive dispatches, when a live commit-ticker fires, when a state changes, that's literally Prime's nervous system showing through.

concept-citation.universal-concept: Below register — Inferno-infra surfacing through Purgatorio-terraces becomes visible at magazine-IA accent scale
